title: Bound and gate code-search measurement scripts
description: Deep-dive audit 2026-08-08 verified that Measure-CodeSearchRelevance.ps1 and Measure-CodeSearchQueries.ps1 call live MCP endpoints with TimeoutSec 3600, record observations without thresholds, and are not CI-gated. Evidence: Scripts/Measure-CodeSearchRelevance.ps1 line 67 and Measure-CodeSearchQueries.ps1 line 60. Add configurable short timeouts, cancellation/retries, deterministic fixture mode, explicit threshold exit codes, and scheduled/manual execution.
